thread:
maria: quick sync — I'm updating the Go + TS SDKs to standardize how API errors map to exceptions and to ensure request IDs are always surfaced in logs. quick questions below

josh: sg. what shape are you thinking for errors? typed ones in Go and Error subclasses in TS?

maria: yes. for Go I want typed errors that implement interface { Code() int; RequestID() string; Retryable() bool } so callers can switch on Code or use errors.As. for TS: Error subclasses like ApiError with fields { status, code, requestId, retryable }

samir: +1. please make sure streaming errors include resume tokens if available. we've seen opaque stream disconnects where clients just retry from start.

maria: good call. plan: for stream-close events, attach metadata: request_id and resume_token when present. example: 
```json
{"error":"connection_lost","request_id":"r-abc123","resume_token":"tok:00043"}
```

kevin: how do we propagate request id from lower-level HTTP libs into the high-level exception? often net/http drops trace headers when using retries.

maria: we will set X-Request-Id from server if present, else generate client-side uuid at the transport layer and attach to ctx. transport returns it on error. code sketch (Go):
```go
// transport.go
reqID := uuid.New().String()
req.Header.Set("X-Request-Id", reqID)
// on response
if resp.Header.Get("X-Request-Id") != "" { reqID = resp.Header.Get("X-Request-Id") }
if resp.StatusCode >= 400 {
  return &ApiError{ status: resp.StatusCode, requestID: reqID, retryable: isRetryable(resp) }
}
```

josh: for TS, the fetch wrapper should attach requestId and return it on error. also include requestId in debug log lines for every request.

maria: agreed. also proposing an sdk-level helper log.Debugf("req=%s method=%s status=%d ...", err.RequestID(), ...). debug logging should be opt-in but easy to enable.

samir: about mapping codes -> retryable: we should centralize rules: 429 and 502-504 = retryable, 401/403 = auth (non-retry), 4xx != 429 = client error non-retry. server 5xx mostly retryable. we can expose IsRetryable() method.

maria: exact plan: publish small table in README and implement helper func IsRetryable(code int) bool. will add unit tests + matrix for streaming vs unary.

kevin: CI / rollout question: can we keep old behavior behind feature-flag so downstreams can migrate? some customers depend on simple string error messages.

maria: yes. default will be new structured errors, flag REDWOOD_SDK_LEGACY_ERR=1 to return legacy strings for short period. will document migration steps.

josh: one more: stack traces in TS — ApiError should capture original fetch Error and include it as .cause so dev tools show better traces. follow Node 16 cause option.

maria: noted. final thing: add small telem event on critical failures with request_id (only when enabled) so SRE can correlate. dev-bot: deploy-preview pipeline will run unit tests on branches with label "sdk-error-mapping".

dev-bot: CI status: tests/units passed (12/12) on maria/sdk-error-mapping. next: integration tests scheduled in 30m. :rocket: 

samir: thanks — i'll review the PR after integration tests. ping me if you want me to validate stream resume behavior with the Java client.

maria: will do. tagging @josh for TS review once go impl looks good. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
